title: SeKV: Resolution-Adaptive KV Cache with Hierarchical Semantic Memory for Long-Context LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2606.31145v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models increasingly operate over long contexts, where the KV cache grows linearly with sequence length and dominates memory during decoding. Token eviction discards entries permanently, and semantic compression fixes each unit's resolution at prefill, so detail that becomes relevant later cannot be recovered. We propose SeKV, a resolution-adaptive KV cache built around a trained zoom-in mechanism that decides at decode time which compressed spans to restore to token resolution. SeKV segments the context at high-surprisal positions, keeps anchor tokens and span summaries on GPU, and offloads low-rank factors of each span's keys and values to CPU. Lightweight per-head routers select query-relevant spans, which are reconstructed with a learned per-span rank. The cache is lossy but non-evicting: every span stays in attention, coarse or reconstructed. The base LLM stays frozen, and the router adds under 0.1% parameters. Acr

translated_title: SeKV：面向长上下文大语言模型推理的分辨率自适应KV缓存与分层语义记忆
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地需要在长上下文上运行，此时KV缓存随序列长度线性增长，并在解码阶段占据主要内存。令牌驱逐方法会永久丢弃条目，而语义压缩则在预填充阶段就固定了每个单元的分辨率，导致后续才变得相关的细节无法恢复。我们提出SeKV，一种分辨率自适应的KV缓存，它围绕一个经过训练的“放大”机制构建，该机制在解码时决定将哪些被压缩的片段恢复到令牌分辨率。SeKV在高惊讶度位置对上下文进行分段，将锚点令牌和片段摘要保留在GPU上，并将每个片段键值的低秩因子卸载到CPU。轻量级的逐头路由器选择与查询相关的片段，并使用学习到的逐片段秩进行重建。该缓存是有损但不驱逐的：每个片段都保留在注意力计算中，无论是粗粒度形式还是重建后的形式。基础大语言模型保持冻结，路由器新增参数不到0.1%。
tldr: SeKV提出了一种分辨率自适应的KV缓存，通过训练的“放大”机制在解码时动态选择需要从压缩状态恢复到令牌分辨率的语义片段，实现了有损但不驱逐、内存高效的长上下文大模型推理。
en_tdlr: SeKV introduces a resolution-adaptive KV cache with a trained zoom-in mechanism that dynamically restores query-relevant compressed spans to token resolution at decode time, achieving lossy yet non-evicting and memory-efficient long-context LLM inference.
